title: Udai Pratap College recorded its June 2026 entrance application window alongside UP agriculture updates
description: Read the June 2026 entrance application timeline at Udai Pratap College, Varanasi and compare admission routes across Uttar Pradesh’s five ICAR-listed institutions.
summary: Udai Pratap College (Autonomous), Varanasi recorded its 2026–27 entrance application window from 16 June to 25 June 2026 in its information brochure, providing a clear benchmark for Uttar Pradesh autonomous and private agriculture admissions.

sections.heading: Udai Pratap College’s 16–25 June 2026 entrance brochure record
paragraphs: [Udai Pratap College](/university/udai-pratap-college) in Varanasi (an autonomous college affiliated to Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith) published its 2026–27 entrance examination brochure recording online application opening on 16 June 2026 and the initial application/fee payment deadline on 25 June 2026.

Autonomous and affiliated colleges in Uttar Pradesh often issue subsequent corrigenda extending deadlines or announcing counselling cutoffs on their notice boards; applicants should check the college portal for post-brochure amendments.

sections.heading: Comparing autonomous colleges and private universities in Uttar Pradesh
paragraphs: Uttar Pradesh’s five researched institutions span two distinct governance models: public-university affiliated colleges—[Udai Pratap College](/university/udai-pratap-college) in Varanasi and [Tilak Dhari P.G. College, Jaunpur](/university/tilak-dhari-pg-college) (affiliated to Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University)—and private universities with their own entrance processes: [Sanskriti University](/university/sanskriti-university) in Mathura, [Integral University, Lucknow](/university/integral-university) (IUET) and [GLA University](/university/gla-university) in Mathura (GLAET).

Compare their fee structures and ICAR accreditation scope using [how to check ICAR accreditation](/articles/icar-accreditation-how-to-check) and [how to compare agriculture fees](/articles/agriculture-fee-budget).

faqs.question: Do Udai Pratap College and Tilak Dhari P.G. College have lower fees than private universities?
faqs.answer: Generally, aided/affiliated colleges under state universities publish lower annual tuition charges than private universities, but you must verify the current session’s exact fee schedule and hostel availability.

faqs.question: How do Integral University and GLA University select B.Sc. Agriculture students?
faqs.answer: Integral University uses IUET and GLA University uses GLAET alongside qualifying Class 12 marks as stated in their admission notices.
